items.title: Food distributor Sysco adds two board members to advance AI transformation
items.summary: Sysco on Thursday said it has appointed two new directors with ‌artificial intelligence and industry expertise, while also ‌strengthening board oversight, as the food distributor pushes ahead with ​its AI-driven transformation. The move comes as food and restaurant companies increasingly adopt AI tools to improve demand forecasting, inventory management, supply-chain planning and customer ‌service. Here are the ⁠details: • Jason Murray, CEO of logistics technology firm Shipium and a former Amazon ⁠executive, and Tom Ondrof, former CFO of food service company Aramark, will join the board on ​September 1, ​increasing its size ​to 13 directors.
